lines.say: Make yourself comfortable now, and when you're ready, let your eyes gently close.
There is nothing you need to do, and nowhere you need to be.
Just let the bed take your weight... and allow yourself to begin to slow down.
With each word I say, you can let go a little more.
Take a slow, easy breath in... through your nose.
And let it go, softly, with a quiet sigh.
Again. Breathe in calm and stillness.
And breathe out, letting your shoulders sink down and soften.
Now just let your breathing find its own slow rhythm. You don't need to control it at all.
Bring a gentle, warm attention to the very top of your head, and let it soften.
Let that softness spread down across your forehead... your eyes... and your jaw.
Feel your neck and shoulders growing heavy, and loose, and warm.
That heavy relaxation flowing down your arms, all the way to your fingertips.
Your chest, and your back, softening a little more with every breath out.
Your hips, and your legs, growing heavier... sinking gently into the bed.
All the way down to your feet. Completely, comfortably relaxed.
In a moment I'll count down from ten. With each number, you can drift twice as deep.
Ten. Sinking down, softly.
Nine. Heavier, and calmer.
Eight. Letting every muscle go.
Seven. Drifting deeper, with nothing to hold onto.
Six. So quiet, and so peaceful.
Five. Halfway down, and still letting go.
Four. Softer, and slower.
Three. Your mind growing calm and still.
Two. Almost there now. Ready to rest.
One. All the way down. Deeply, completely relaxed.
From here, sleep can come easily, all on its own. You don't need to reach for it.
Every sound you hear only carries you deeper, and lets you rest more completely.
Your body already knows how to sleep. You can simply allow it to happen.
Drifting, softly... like sinking into warm, still water.
There's nothing to think about now. Any thought can float by, like a cloud, and drift away.
Deeper... and warmer... and more at peace.
Letting go, drifting gently down into sleep.
